problem: On a real device the onboarding guide (ce5d189) rendered the brand, page glow, P2 orbit, pagination, skip and final CTA — but the emoji, title and body were INVISIBLE on all 4 pages. Root cause = ANIMATION_VISIBILITY_STATE: content base state was `opacity:0` and visibility depended entirely on the `.is-active` entry animation executing with `animation-fill-mode:both`. The animation shorthand also embedded the token variable `var(--ease-out)`. If the animation is dropped/fails on device, content stays at base opacity:0 forever, while `.footer` (no base opacity:0) remains visible — exactly the reported symptom. Fix restores a safe visible base state so content is visible WITHOUT animation; animation is now enhancement-only.

forensics.BEFORE_base: .slide .visual-emoji{opacity:0;transform:scale(.92)} / .slide .slide-title{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16rpx)} / .slide .slide-body{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12rpx)}; visibility gated on .slide.is-active animation ... both with var(--ease-out)
forensics.AFTER_base: .slide .visual-emoji, .slide .slide-title, .slide .slide-body { opacity:1; visibility:visible; transform:none }  (safe default; animation only augments)
forensics.var_in_animation: var(--ease-out) -> explicit ease-out on all animation/transition declarations in this page
forensics.evidence: CDP probe: animations running -> opacity 1; animations stripped -> opacity 0 (BEFORE fix) / opacity 1 (AFTER fix). Animation-stripped screenshots show real ink on all 4 pages after fix.
forensics.fail_safe: Even if the is-active binding or the animation never fires, base state keeps content visible.
